author: Arnav
problem: A museum gives a free tote bag to every n-th visitor through the door, but no one gets more than one bag. visitors lists names in arrival order. Return the winners in the order they won.
bug_description: Slices visitors[::n], which picks the 1st, (n+1)-th, ... visitors instead of the n-th, 2n-th, ...

comments.accurate: Gives a bag to each n-th visitor, skipping anyone who already has one
comments.wrong_behavior: Gives a bag to the first visitor and every n-th one after that, one bag per person
comments.wrong_location: Winner selection verified; the duplicate check is linear and may need a set
